note: Included events began Monday 23 November 2026. Times are first reports in UTC. Date Check gives event dates.

leads.head: NATO calls urgent talks over Russia
leads.sub: Finland summons Russian envoy over suspected airspace violation. NATO radar plane for Poland. Moscow says Estonia risks “open war”.

leads.head: Reuters finds hidden Ebola graves
leads.sub: Graves point to a higher toll. WHO chief calls for peace amid heavy fighting.

leads.head: India pledges $1.6bn to Nepal in a reset
leads.sub: Flood relief as new PM Balendra Shah meets Modi in Delhi.

cards.sub: Women's: US, Mexico, Costa Rica, Jamaica in 2031; UK in 2035

cards.label: MOLLY MELDRUM, 83
cards.head: Australian music legend Molly Meldrum dies
cards.sub: Countdown host saluted by Kylie Minogue, Jimmy Barnes

cards.label: NVIDIA +30%
cards.head: Huang back at Nvidia; Wall St surges
cards.sub: Nasdaq +6.5% Mon. Trump says he 'convinced' the board.

cards.label: TOXIC RISK

cards.sub: Oxfam: signs of possible contamination almost everywhere

cards.label: FLIGHTS GROUNDED
cards.head: Belgian strike halts all flights
cards.sub: Airports shut 06:00–20:00 UTC. Rail hit. PM gives coalition until year-end to agree cuts.

cards.sub: Protests go on. Current minimum wage: about $100 a month.
